violations.message: In the 2D view the J1 screw terminal sits inside the dashed courtyard of the bottom-left mounting hole (screw head would collide with the connector body), and in 3d_top the channel passive rows are nearly touching the tops of the THT terminal bodies.

Reference designators are rendered directly on top of their own component pads (e.g. C2/D1/R1 text struck through by pads) and the R10/R9/C1 labels stack on each other beside U1, so legends would be clipped or illegible after fab.

Roughly the top two-thirds of the board is empty dead space (only the lone J5 header floats there) while all channels, passives, and terminals are congested into the bottom quarter, so the area is used disproportionately.

In every channel the terminal's left pin (AIN) connects up-right to the series R while the right pin (GND) connects up-left to C/D (e.g. J1 pin1 at x~105 to R1 at x~222 crosses GND pad at x~177 to C2 at x~138), producing an X in the ratsnest that forces crossover traces on all four channels.
